decisionsTitle: Volunteers for a race: the event's own roles, the organizers' list and a public form behind the privacy notice
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «I want to register volunteers for a race and be able to define custom roles». Asked how, he chose **a public form on the race's page as well as the organizers' own list**, and **roles defined per event**.

**Decision.** An event's editor (§406) gets one more card beside its to-dos (§749), **«Voluntari»**, folded, with the closed line «N din M» (people counted over people needed) and «K de confirmat», and open on arrival while anybody waits for an answer. It holds three things, all plain forms that work with scripts off and all asserted again by the service (BR-REQ-060-01):

1. **The roles** — `event_volunteer_roles`: a name in Română **and** English (both or neither, §352 — the bilingual rule), how many people it needs (1–1000), optionally one line of what the person does in both languages, and a position the arrows set. They belong to **one date** (a weekly series' dates and a copy of an event start with none, like the to-dos), at most thirty an event. A role with people on it — cancelled ones too, the foreign key is `RESTRICT` — cannot be deleted (`VOLUNTEER_ROLE_HAS_PEOPLE`: move them or delete them first).
2. **The people** — `event_volunteers`: name, address, telephone number (E.164), role, a state «Înscris» / «Confirmat» / «Anulat», a source (the club's hand, or the page's form), the person's message, the organizers' own note (backoffice only) and, for a sign-up on the page, the version of the privacy notice that was in force. The address goes through the versioned canonicalizer (AGENTS.md §10.4) and `UNIQUE (event_id, canonical_email)` makes it **one row per person per event**, whoever typed it and whatever the role. The card lists them grouped by role with «N din M» each (`Înscris` + `Confirmat` count; `Anulat` never), and the organizers add one by hand (a role may then take more people than it asked), change any box, confirm, cancel, reopen and delete, and download a CSV (the registrations' `csvCell`, a BOM, one `volunteer.exported` audit row with a count). Every change is audited with ids and the names of the fields changed — **never a name, an address, a telephone number or a message**, so deleting a volunteer leaves nothing of the person in the trail.
3. **«Primește voluntari»** — an event tick, off by default, written by the card's own form and never by the editor's save (so an open editor's save is not made stale). The card says in one line whether the public form is on the page now and, if not, which condition is missing.

**The public form, «Vreau să fiu voluntar»**, on the event page — a fold under the programme — is drawn only while **(a)** the event takes volunteers, **(b)** at least one role still needs people, **(c)** the privacy notice in force describes volunteers in **every** language — and the event is neither cancelled nor over, published and not for the members alone. The service asks all of it again at every post (the page's cache is not the gate). It reuses the house: the telephone box and its country picker of the registration form, the honeypot, the timing check and Turnstile when it is on, the same classification of a trap holding the person's own address (§282) and of a missing render time (§217), `?volunteer=` answers through the event page's live twin (`i18n/live-twin.ts`), the refused form's typed values in the sealed draft cookie (§142) — read only by the twin, so the static page still reaches no cookie (`tests/unit/public-cache/static-public-routes.test.ts` names the one file it allows and why) — and a consent tick that names the notice. A role that fills while the form is open is refused politely, the others offered (`full`); the role's row is locked while its people are counted, so two people cannot take the last place together. A person whose post took the very last place — or found it gone — still gets their answer: the box stays, with the sentence and no form (`volunteerBoxRoles`), never a page where the box has silently vanished. Two throttles on top of the house's: three posts an hour per address (`volunteer-signup`) and sixty an hour per event (`volunteer-event`), because every sign-up also mails each organizer.

**One answer.** A sign-up that is a repeat — the same canonical address for the same event, whatever the spelling, the role or the row's state, an organizer's «Anulat» included — changes nothing, sends nothing and gets the very same answer a new one gets — «am primit», or «the role has filled» when the role it names is full, which is asked first for everybody, so even a forged post naming a full role tells a listed person from a stranger by nothing — and the form is no oracle for who volunteers (BR-REQ-031-01 criterion 3).

**Why no confirmation link to the address first** (AGENTS.md §10.4, §12.8). A registration confirms its address because the confirmation holds a place and binds a declaration. A sign-up here holds nothing, binds nothing and gives the sender nothing to act with: the one email the address gets carries no token and no link that does anything, the list is read only by the organizers, and an organizer's «Confirmat» — made after speaking to the person — is the real proof that the address is theirs. The worst a stranger's typing does is one polite email, which the throttles bound; the group runs' self-declaration (§393) takes an unconfirmed address the same way.

**Email**, through the outbox in the same transaction as the row (BR-REQ-080-02): `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` to the person in the page's language (both halves, the role and the event's facts on the platform's bold line, the public's privacy line, no button), and `VOLUNTEER_CLUB_NOTICE` to every Organizer, Administrator and Superadministrator in the language of their own row (who and which role — never the address or the number — and a button to the card). There are no per-person notification preferences in the house, so every colleague who may read the list is told; a «who is told» list on `/admin/emails` is the follow-up if the club wants it narrower. A message whose volunteer was cancelled or deleted before it left is withdrawn.

**The privacy notice.** The template gains `{{volunteers}}` in section 5 — a paragraph saying what an offer keeps (name, address, telephone number, role, message, the organizers' note), why (consent, art. 6(1)(a), for the public form; legitimate interest, art. 6(1)(f), for a person an organizer enters), what is sent, that it is no race registration and on no public list, and who sees it — and a line in section 7: **thirty days after the event's start**. The marker is the switch (`describesVolunteers`, `noticeDescribesVolunteers`, `cachedVolunteersDescribed`, the token's legend entry), §562's, §613's and §683's pattern, **and the template is all the platform writes**: only a version the club approves in `/admin/legal` has effect, a lawyer reads the paragraph and the thirty days first (open for counsel: the bases and the period), and §639's email tells the Administrators the template moved. `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteersNotice` while an event ahead takes volunteers and no approved notice carries the marker (open, never blocking; done by itself the day one does; absent while nothing waits on it). `CLAUDE.md`'s «Still owed» item 16 and `SETUP.md` §44 say so.

**Retention.** The maintenance job's new step `volunteers` deletes the offers thirty days after the event's start, whatever their state (`RETENTION_PERIODS.volunteerDaysAfterEvent`, which the notice's section 7 and a unit test hold to the same number); the roles, which hold no name, stay with the event. «Toate datele unei persoane» lists a person's offers with every column and counts them in its export, so an access request is complete; deletion is the card's «Șterge voluntarul».

**The event's JSON file (§751).** It carries neither the people — personal data — nor the roles nor the tick. The roles hold no person and could travel, but they belong to one date: a copy of an event and a series' other dates start with none and the tick off, like the to-dos (§749), and the file is a copy by another road. So an import as new starts with no role and the form off, and an import over an event leaves that event's own roles, people and tick exactly as they were; no configuration was added to the file, so `FIELD_LABELS` and the catalogues are unchanged (`tests/integration/events/event-json.test.ts` holds all three).

**Who.** Reading and writing are one set, `canManageVolunteers` — the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator, written as `canReadRegistrations` so moving that line moves this one — because an address and a telephone number are personal data the Tehnic role never receives (§289). The Tehnic role, the Redactor, a volunteer and a member see no card and are refused by every action and by the export route.

**Refused.** A club-wide list of roles (the owner chose per event; a copy of an event copies none). Volunteers as staff accounts (they sign in nowhere and are not on «Echipa»). Volunteers on the public participant list or in any count the club is given (§32, §30 — a volunteer is not a registration and takes no place of the capacity; `registrations/` is untouched). An email confirmation link before the offer is kept (above). A volunteer's address or telephone number on any public page, in an audit row or in the organizers' email. A notification-preferences table nobody asked for. Counting only the confirmed against a role's need — a role then never fills, and the form never says so.

**Migration `0146_event_volunteers`**, generated by drizzle-kit after the club release's `0145_public_list_club` and sorting after it, is expand-only: two enums, two tables and `events.accepts_volunteers boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`, and two values on `email_message_type`; nothing that exists changes. Deleting an event takes its roles and its people with it (the role's `RESTRICT` guards a role's own delete, never the event's cascade; a test holds it).
changelogLine: - **Volunteers for a race** — an event's editor gets a card «Voluntari»: the organizers define the event's own roles in Română and English (how many people each needs, in the order they choose), enter people by hand, confirm or cancel them and download the list, and tick «Primește voluntari» for the event's page to show «Vreau să fiu voluntar» — name, address, telephone, role, message and a consent tick, behind the registration form's anti-bot checks, shown only while a role still needs people and the privacy notice in force describes volunteers (the template's new `{{volunteers}}`, to be approved; `/admin/tasks` has the row). The person gets one email of receipt, each Organizer and Administrator a notice; a repeat gets the same answer; a volunteer is not a registration, takes no place and is on no public list; the offers go thirty days after the event. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event's editor opened by the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator, when it renders, then a folded card «Voluntari» says «N din M» (people counted, «Înscris» and «Confirmat» only, over people needed) and «K de confirmat», is open on arrival while anybody is «Înscris», and holds the event's roles — each with a name in Română and in English, how many people it needs (1 to 1000), optionally a line of what the person does in both languages or in neither, in the order the arrows set — added, changed, moved and deleted by plain forms that work with scripts off; a role with one name missing, a number that is not 1 to 1000, or half a description is refused naming the box with every box kept; a role with people on it, cancelled ones included, is refused (`VOLUNTEER_ROLE_HAS_PEOPLE`) until they are moved or deleted; an event takes at most thirty roles; a role belongs to one date, and a copy of an event, like a series' other dates, has none (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/card.test.ts`; unit `volunteers/volunteer.test.ts`; e2e `volunteers.spec.ts`.

Given the card, when an organizer enters a person by hand, changes any box (the role included, and a note shown to the organizers alone), confirms, cancels, reopens or deletes, then the address goes through the versioned canonicalizer and the event holds one row per person — case, whitespace and a Gmail tag are one address, refused naming the box (`VOLUNTEER_ALREADY_LISTED`) — the telephone number is kept as one E.164 number, typed with its country code or as a Romanian number; each change that changes something writes one audit row with ids, states and the names of the fields changed and never a name, an address, a telephone number, a message or a note, a press that changes nothing writes nothing, and a deleted volunteer leaves nothing of the person in the trail; the list is grouped by role with «N din M» and downloads as a CSV with a BOM through the registrations' `csvCell`, recorded as `volunteer.exported` with a count (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/card.test.ts`; e2e `volunteers.spec.ts`.

Given an event's volunteers, when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator — the Tehnic role, the Redactor, a volunteer, a member, a stranger — asks to read or change a role, a person, the tick «Primește voluntari» or the CSV, then the service and the export route refuse (FORBIDDEN, 403, 401 for a stranger) whatever the card drew, the editor draws the card for none of them, and nothing is written (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/card.test.ts`; unit `staff/roles.test.ts`.

Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens its page, then «Vreau să fiu voluntar» is drawn — a fold with the roles that still need people and how many, a role choice, the name, the address, a telephone number with its country, an optional message of at most 300 characters and one consent tick that names the privacy notice — only while (a) the event takes volunteers, (b) at least one role still needs people, (c) the privacy notice in force describes volunteers in every language, and the event is scheduled, published, ahead and not for the members alone; a post asks all of it again and is refused (CONFLICT, the page then shows no form) when any fails; a role that has filled while the form was open is refused politely with the others offered, and a post that took — or found gone — the very last place still shows its answer in the box, with no form; the role's row is locked while its people are counted, so two people never take the last place; a malformed address, a telephone number that cannot be dialled, a missing name or role of this event, or an unticked consent is the person's own fix, naming each box, with what was typed kept in the sealed draft (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`; unit `volunteers/volunteer.test.ts` (`volunteerBoxRoles`); e2e `volunteers.spec.ts`.

Given the volunteer form, when it is posted, then the house's defences answer exactly as the registration form's do — Turnstile when it is on, a filled honeypot (unless it holds the person's own address) and a post within the second of its render are answered like a success and keep nothing, a missing render time is nobody's fault — a throttle allows three posts an hour per canonical address and sixty per event, said plainly; and a repeat of the same canonical address for the same event, whatever the role and whatever the row's state, changes nothing, sends nothing and is answered exactly as a new sign-up — «am primit», or «full» on a role that has filled, judged first for everybody — so the form is no oracle for who volunteers; no confirmation link to the address is asked first, the one email it gets carries no token and no link that does anything (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`; e2e `volunteers.spec.ts`.

Given a new public sign-up, when it is kept, then the row, one `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` to the person in the page's language (the role and the event's start and place on the platform's bold line, the public's privacy line, both halves, no button and no token) and one `VOLUNTEER_CLUB_NOTICE` to each Organizer, Administrator and Superadministrator in the language of their own row (who and which role, never the address or the telephone number, and a button to the event's «Voluntari» card) are written in one transaction; the Tehnic role is not told; a message whose volunteer was cancelled or deleted before it left is withdrawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`; unit `notifications/*` (every message type placed).

Given the privacy notice's template, then it names `{{volunteers}}` in section 5 (what an offer keeps, why, who sees it) and says in section 7 thirty days after the event's start; the marker is the form's switch — no event page offers «Vreau să fiu voluntar» and no sign-up is kept while the notice in force does not name it in every language — and `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteersNotice` while an event ahead takes volunteers and no approved notice carries it, done by itself once one does; the platform approves nothing (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/volunteer.test.ts`, `diagnostics/owner-tasks.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`.

Given volunteers' offers, when the maintenance job runs, then those of an event that started more than thirty days ago are deleted whatever their state, those of a nearer event stay, and the roles, which hold no name, stay; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists a person's offers by canonical address with every column and counts them in its export (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`, `registrations/person-data.test.ts`.

Migration `0146_event_volunteers` is expand-only: it adds the enums `event_volunteer_state` and `event_volunteer_source`, the tables `event_volunteer_roles` (the event with `ON DELETE CASCADE`, `CHECK`s on the number needed and the lengths) and `event_volunteers` (the event with `ON DELETE CASCADE`, the role with `ON DELETE RESTRICT`, `UNIQUE (event_id, canonical_email)`), the column `events.accepts_volunteers` with default false, and the values `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` and `VOLUNTEER_CLUB_NOTICE` of `email_message_type`, and changes nothing that exists (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that takes volunteers, when its public page, its public cache or its JSON file (§751) is read, then none carries a volunteer's name, address, telephone number, message or note — the page reads each role's names, description and how many people it still needs, nothing of a person — no volunteer is on the public participant list or in any count of registrations, and the file carries neither the roles nor the tick «Primește voluntari», so an import as new starts with none and an import over an event leaves its own untouched (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/signup.test.ts`, `events/event-json.test.ts`.
